purpose: Prescribed (non-manufactured) forcing; vary the Gaussian budget P; compare S, NC, C (paper's chain solver, forcing energy) with fixed-centre Gaussian Galerkin and P1 finite elements.
objective: exact whole-line Gaussian H1 Gram; 768-node Gauss-Legendre rule on [-12,12] for load and nonlinear terms; normalized by Q[f^2]; no reference information during optimization
reference: solve_bvp with decay conditions u'=u at -L, u'=-u at +L; L=12 tol 1e-10 and L=14 tol 3e-11 (errors use the latter); staged from tol 1e-6
error: relative H1 error against the reference with a 1536-node Gauss-Legendre rule on [-12,12]

collision_flags.C: a pair at t=0, a completion, or a completed chain at the end
collision_flags.NC: a pair with h<=1e-6 sigma, or largest ordinary weight >1e6
collision_flags.S: smallest centre spacing <=1e-3 sigma, or largest weight >1e6

baselines.gaussian_galerkin: P fixed equispaced centres on [-L,L], L in {0.5,...,6} by smallest energy
baselines.fem_p1: n interior nodes on [-L,L], zero Dirichlet, L in {3,...,12} by smallest energy, n in {4,...,512}

validation: finite-difference gradient check (max abs diff 2.2e-11); P=2 single-source reproduces the paper's 0.66
